_instructions: One file for everything on the Updates page. Copy the block that matches what you're publishing, fill it in, save. 'type' controls which tab it appears under and how the card is drawn. For podcasts and webinars, this site never hosts the audio/video itself — put the real links (YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Zoom recording, etc.) in 'links', and optionally an 'embedUrl' (a YouTube/Spotify embed link) to show a preview player right on the page. podcastSeries defines the show metadata; podcast items reference seriesId.
